title: What BART paid for wireless service on purchasing cards

beats.text: BART auditors found 277 Verizon charges on employee purchasing cards.

visual.sub: Auditors found 277 wireless charges on BART purchasing cards

beats.text: The charges totaled $12,207 across two years.

visual.kicker: Auditors found 277 wireless charges on BART purchasing cards

beats.text: They compared a $44.07 charge with a lower state rate.

visual.kicker: Auditors found 277 wireless charges on BART purchasing cards

beats.text: Their largest scenario assumed 300 lines. The actual number of eligible lines was unknown.

visual.kicker: One annual figure in the audit does not match its monthly figure

beats.text: We found a $216 error in the annual cost for 100 lines.
The savings column still adds up.

beats.text: BART said it secured a different plan at $36.99 a month.
